_comment: Edge rule set from docs/architecture/2026-09-13-global-scale-cell-architecture-and-ddos.md §5.3. ONE source of truth: every provider module (edge-cloudflare, edge-aws, edge-azure) renders these into its own rate-limit, cache and size-limit primitives, so a change here is a change everywhere and the count in the design table equals the count in the code. Paths are prefixes. requests_per_minute is per source address at the edge; the tenant- and user-aware budgets live in APISIX and the Go admission layer, which know things the edge cannot.

rate_rules.name: auth-ui
rate_rules.description: Credential-submitting UI paths: login, MFA, passwordless, magic link, password reset.

rate_rules.name: token
rate_rules.description: Token endpoint. Public clients retry on 401; the budget is generous per source and the per-client budget lives in APISIX.

rate_rules.name: scim
rate_rules.description: SCIM provisioning. Bulk callers are few and known; a flood here is a directory-sync bug or an attack.

rate_rules.name: audit-search
rate_rules.description: Full-text audit search is the most expensive read the platform serves.

cache_rules.name: discovery
cache_rules.description: OIDC discovery and JWKS: public, identical for every caller, and the first thing a JWKS flood hits.

cache_rules.name: spa-assets
cache_rules.description: Hashed console bundles are immutable by name.
